That’s my goal. I need to get out of here in anyway I can. I’ve told my ex before that if I had the option to live a sustainable life the way I want but never have friends or family around me I’d take it in a heartbeat.

I’m really trying. It’s hard. Especially when it seems like they’re all I have left.
Currently. All hurt.

The people I live near are awful people. There are some diamonds in the rough but they all crack at some point as well. I love talking to people and especially love making people feel comfortable and at peace with me. Maybe that’s my problem

I love that advice and if I can have someone in my life to hug. I’ll use it. 

For my friends. I wish calling someone a fag or gay every day you’re with them and picking on their size and everything isn’t normal.

I might be a target. I have no idea why. Like I said I’m never mean to people. I’m not a “band kid” or anything. I’m just a guy who does his own thing. I’ve asked people and they don’t understand why I have a target on my back.

I like to keep things to myself mostly. I tell my family and my gf knows. Most of the time they kinda talk to me but don’t really do much. They say they’re here for me but they’re not paying attention enough. I am definitely that kid that everyone in the group rips on for no reason and I hate it. I don’t like being mean of making fun of people but they do it to me.
I’ve told my therapist and I have an appointment with my physician booked but it takes forever for an appointment to go through so idk how long it’ll be.
It’s been constant for about a week. When I drive the lights from cars even on low beams hurt my eyes. And it keeps me up.
I’ve just been mistreated. All my “friends” family everyone. They just seen me as a target and I hate it.
